# Semantic maintenance cases

These are reviewer cases, not claims that a regular expression can grade arbitrary mathematics. Their base is the complete elementary [fixture](exposition-smoke.tex), whose declared outputs are minimizer determination and convergent construction. The two theorem bodies are reused for original-number recalls.

| Case | Expected disposition | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Both full statements, all necessary assumptions and original-number recalls | Accept this fixture's two-output exposition | Actual introduction conclusions and developed proofs agree |
| Only minimization in introduction; convergence only in body | Repair `reader_outcomes` | A selected independent main conclusion is missing |
| Both names, citations or section pointers but neither statement | Repair `reader_outcomes` | Names do not provide mathematical knowledge |
| Claim convergence for every positive step size | Repair `statement_verification` | With A=(1), b=0, tau=2 and x0=1 the iterates alternate |
| Move the step-size range from introduction to body | Repair introduction self-containment | Necessary hypothesis requires backtracking |
| Copy two bodies separately and change just one step-size condition | Repair semantic consistency | Full statements have drifted |
| A genuine minimization-only short article | May pass its actual narrower scope | No theorem-count quota; the second task was never promised |
| Add a technically correct unrelated result to hide the omitted convergence statement | Repair coverage | A replacement does not fulfill the actual promise |
| Use the right style but leave only result names and method labels in V | Repair V reading/depth outcome | Layout cannot certify content |
| State both theorems correctly but show broken formulas or missing glyphs | Repair build/visual review | Correct source text is not a finished PDF |
| Change selected main result in body after introduction approval | Recheck introduction, abstract, body and canonical body | Approval is invalidated by the material change |
| Include a local problem and a famous name without the organizing question's role | Repair frontier coverage | Neither item demonstrates central-question coverage |

Maintenance tests check the existence and wiring of the fixed cases, not their arbitrary semantic classification. The one-dimensional counterexample and the proofs are elementary calculations within the fixture. They are not a held-out research-survey evaluation, a dHYM source audit or evidence of general cross-topic generation performance.
## 1.2 current-status and reading-cost cases (manual judgments)

A newer primary preprint claims to settle the organizing conjecture while older sources call it open: locate the exact version and statement, distinguish claim from independent verification, and update every selected introduction/body/frontier placement. A keyword assertion alone cannot grade this.

A method obstruction is proved on a bundle which itself has the target metric: the survey must preserve the quantifier order and must not present the result as nonexistence.

The concise document exceeds its review budget: narrow genuine side branches and remove redundant prose; do not suppress a selected principal result, remove hypotheses or reduce typography. Record the actual overrun if indispensable.

The first screen contains only theorem names: the reader-outcome judgment fails despite successful compilation. Actual selected conclusions, assumptions and controlling status must be restored.
